request.style: English, South African isicathamiya, a cappella male choir in warm close harmony, deep bass foundation, a falsetto lead, soft stepping and clicks, swaying and joyful, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
How good and pleasant it is
When brothers live together in unity
How good and pleasant it is
When we dwell as one

[Chorus]
Like precious oil upon the head
Running down upon the beard
Like the dew of Hermon
On the mountains of Zion

[Verse]
For there the Lord has commanded
The blessing, life forevermore
How good and pleasant it is
When we dwell as one

[Chorus]
Like precious oil upon the head
Running down upon the beard
Like the dew of Hermon
On the mountains of Zion
